scope: Two frozen new verifier/test files; actual archive downloads and combined Publisher execution remain pending. No source edits, downloads, tests or extraction performed by this reviewer.
reviewed_contract: Exactly three distinct API35/API37/runtime artifact IDs are selected from the complete original metadata list; current repository,2020workflow, source and run are required. Current job-success/attempt chronology remains a separate mandatory C4Publisher check.

gh api downloads the exact repository/artifact endpoint into one newly created temporary file at a time, with a900sprocess bound. It does not print credentials, redirect/error bodies or stderr. Failed download does not enter archive validation.
Actual complete ZIP size and SHA256 must equal GitHub metadata before inspecting any contents.

ZIP members reject duplicate names, traversal, absolute/drive/backslash paths, control characters, encryption, symlinks/special nodes and file/directory prefix collisions. Empty directories are read as well; every regular member is streamed to EOF so zipfile validates its CRC.

The entire downloaded original directory is enumerated without following symlinks, and its file set must exactly equal ZIPregularmembers. Each file is opened through O_NOFOLLOW relative directory descriptors; every byte is compared streamwise with the original member.

Per-file device/inode/size/mtime/ctime are checked before and after comparison, the directory inventory is checked again, and size/membermanifest/hash evidence is recorded. No archive extraction or original-directory write occurs.
Temporary archive cleanup is retained even on failure. Three original-directory roots must be distinct/nonoverlapping; the new output must be outside all three and cannot replace an existing report.

actual_test_log_read.scope: Synthetic metadata and temporary ZIP/filesystem counterexamples; no actual GitHub artifact download.

integration_obligations: Run this verifier on the three full directories produced by the actual original download before any derived file is inserted into them. Do not pass only connect-four subdirectories or selectively extracted files.
Require successful original-archive verification AND the separate C4PublisherValidator. This archive verifier deliberately does not replace gameplay, current successful job or visual evidence gates.

Retain its output outside the originaldirectories and include it with the final delivery receipt. The surrounding workflow must install/authenticate gh and grant only the existing read access needed for these artifacts.
